scope: independent Python mechanism diagnosis; no optimizer changes or HV claims
profile_rule: rates divided by nominal median base; independent per-worker U[.85,1.15]; h0=0; synthetic only
normalization: one frozen parent objective vector for all candidates and methods in a case
candidates: same-factory two-job worker/resource/order/insert/joint edits, FA fixed; job-owned resources follow JS
prediction: changed stage0 modules including directly rewired successors at OLD cached states; old costates plus direct cost defects; later topology frozen
time_only: stop fatigue-state derivatives on same dynamic forward; ordinary critical path for Cmax, generalized time-channel for TEC/TWC
ties_and_random: exact uniform expectation on minimum-score ties; random uniform on entire identical pool, no truth-based choice
truth: all candidates fully decoded and validated only after scores/choices fixed; no feedback to prediction or pool
accepted_gain: mean(max(0,-actual normalized scalar delta)) for uniform selected ties; same reject-if-worse rule
bootstrap: 2000 hierarchical paired resamples, instance then parent seed; separately per profile and target; descriptive with six instances
timing: single thread, warmed perf_counter_ns; components measured separately; all repeats and full decode calls retained
decision_cost_proxy: guided: 2*trace_decode+pool+adjoint+defects+scores+choice; random: 2*plain_decode+pool+random_choice; one target/one child, not a full optimizer benchmark
success: correct dynamics/derivatives, same legal pools, complete truth and cost accounting; superiority is NOT a completion criterion
no_tuning: do not change cases, profiles, pools or thresholds after results; preserve failed runs
